issues.problem: The ribs read as crisp white drawn outlines. They also run across the bright cove band and the grille, all the way to the outboard bin crest. In c120 a joint is a soft light ridge about 1.1x the vault with a faint shadow, and it stops at the grille frame. The cove field and the grille run unbroken, apart from the grille's own bridges.
issues.evidence: v6 row 150: rib 223 on a 157-164 vault (1.36-1.42x, about 3 px wide). c120 col 760: rib 194 on 167-174 (1.12x). r7st h_trough/g_latch and the v6 crop show the rib arc crossing the cove band to the bin edge. In the c120 crop the joint ends at the grille frame.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js ribPath(): start the path inboard of the grille. Use t = TROUGH.ts[0] + 0.035 + (0.98 - TROUGH.ts[0] - 0.035) * k / 60 instead of 0.02 + 0.98*k/60. Keep RIB.t0 0.6 so the turn stays put. Move the baked-falloff loop so it runs after the rib, crest-rib, speaker and emergency-light adds, and skip only cove and grille vertices (|x| > xg - TROUGH.w/2). Then the ribs take the same x0.85..0.66 as the vault. Set CEILMAT.rib e 0.06 -> 0.02 and c '#f0eeea' -> '#ecebe7'. Set ribShadow '#b9b9b6' -> '#c6c5c1'.
